messages:
paul: FYI we have an RFP follow-up: gov org requires air-gapped POC + production option. Key asks: encrypted physical media, offline activation, signed SBOM/provenance, monthly security deltas, and liability language for media transit. Need a quick scoping note + price band for offline packaging to include in the response. @anika can you lead tech presales?

anika: Happy to. Two quick clarifiers: 1) Media preference (SSD vs USB)? 2) Max single-file they can accept? 3) Do they want vendor-managed signing or customer keypair?

diego: They prefer encrypted SSD cartridges (preferred) or multiple signed USBs. Customer expects strict chain-of-custody. Single-file cap is ~200GB but they asked for recommendations.

maria: Ops notes: For single artifacts >30GB we require multipart archives with resume logic. For >150GB we recommend NVMe cartridges. We provide a small offline verifier tool and signed manifest.

maria: Example manifest we include in deliveries:

```
manifest_version: "1"
artifacts:
  - name: model-2026-int8.bin
    parts: ["part-A","part-B","part-C"]
    sha256: cafebabecafebabecafebabe...
signed_by: redwood-release
provenance: model-2026-provenance.signed.tar.gz
```

anika: Security: customer requires FIPS-validated signing, ability to rotate certs offline, reproducible build logs for quantized artifacts, and option to hold keys in customer HSM. If they want us to manage keys with escrow that will add cost and lead time.

diego: Activation flows available: CSR -> signed activation token -> offline import, or HW-bound license file. Both support offline verification and a documented import playbook.

paul: Buyer asked if we can do monthly security-only deltas + quarterly feature bundles. They want guaranteed windows for critical patches. Can we commit?

maria: Yes: offer monthly security deltas and quarterly feature drops. Caveat: quantized-delta generation often needs a full image rebuild for validation; typical delta prep 24-72h, call this out in the SOW.

anika: Commercial: buyer wants a ballpark for offline packaging & signing + one week on-site validation. Need a not-to-exceed band to include.

legal-bot: Reminder: include export-control clause for quantized weights and liability language for loss/damage of physical media. Also call out procurement lead time for HSMs if requested.

paul: Ballpark range from finance/ops: $25k-$65k for offline packaging, signing, and provenance work (depends on artifact count and HSM/escrow). On-site days billed separately. Final quote after BOM.

danika: can you confirm the timeline if they ask for vendor-produced quantized artifacts?

anika: If we produce quantized artifacts: add 12-36h prebuild and 24-72h delta prep; reproducible-build logs and signed SBOM included. Need ML sign-off on fidelity.

diego: Acceptance checklist to include in SOW draft:
- delivered media verifies against offline CA and signatures
- SBOM + signed provenance provided
- installer runs with no external DNS/NTP and fails safe on signature mismatch
- chunked install resumes after interruption and verifies checksums
- cert rotation validated in staging offline rig (no internet)
- rollback to previous signed bundle validated within SLA window (e.g., 6h)

paul: Action items: 1) I'll request BOM + media preference and confirm single-file sizes (ETA: EOD). 2) @anika to get ML lead sign-off on quantized fidelity and delta timelines. 3) @maria to run a chunked-install smoke on staging offline rig and post logs. 4) Legal to draft liability & escrow language.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: staging offline rig maintenance window scheduled 2026-04-08 02:00-04:00 UTC - OK to run chunked install tests.

diego: Note: if customer requires vendor HSM with escrow, add procurement lead time 6+ weeks and escalated security review. Call that out.

paul: I'll include the three signing options (customer key, vendor HSM customer-held, vendor HSM with escrow) and the price band in the reply. We'll recommend encrypted NVMe + signed manifest and resumable installer as the default. Keeping this thread as the tracker.

anika: Acked. I'll draft the tech annex and drop it here once ML confirms quantization caveats. :thumbsup:
